blocks.text: In the DLI Grammar Reference Book
The conjugation of this verb is irregular: in singular - "**Е**" type, in plural - "**И**" type.

Verbs which have in the infinitive a consonant before **-ть** (**-ти**) or end with **-чь** have the past tense as follows: **есть** — **ел**, **ела**; **идти** — **шёл**, **шла**, **шло**, **шли**; **мочь** — **мог**, **могла**, **могло**, **могли**.
